title: CausalCache: Conditional High-Fidelity Restoration for Long-Horizon GUI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.22577v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-horizon GUI agents can retain a complete interaction trace cheaply as textual action records, but expose only a few past events to the policy in high-fidelity pixels. We formulate this as conditional fidelity restoration: each event persists in summary-only form and is linked to an archived screenshot, while an active visual-context budget $B$ limits how many events may be promoted to summary-plus-image form. Recent-$B$ spends every slot on the latest events. CausalCache instead reallocates the same $B$ promotions over the complete trace, evicting a recent image only when a distant event has higher conditional marginal utility. Its history-gated key/value (HGKV) adapter modifies only restored history-image tokens and is exactly bypassed with no history image. Matched-budget replacement groups and per-arm-anchored difference-in-differences supervision make uniform history amplification worth zero; a budget-aware selector then chooses

translated_title: CausalCache：面向长程GUI智能体的条件高保真恢复
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.22577v1 公告类型：新 摘要：长程GUI智能体可以将完整的交互轨迹以文本动作记录的形式低成本地保留，但仅向策略暴露少量过去事件的高保真像素。我们将此问题表述为条件保真恢复：每个事件以仅摘要形式持久化，并与存档截图关联，而活动视觉上下文预算$B$限制了可提升为摘要加图像形式的事件数量。Recent-$B$策略将所有槽位用于最新事件。CausalCache则重新分配相同的$B$个提升机会于完整轨迹上，仅当远处事件具有更高的条件边际效用时，才驱逐近期图像。其历史门控键/值（HGKV）适配器仅修改恢复的历史图像令牌，并在无历史图像时完全旁路。匹配预算替换组和基于臂锚定的差异-差异监督使统一历史放大效果为零；随后，预算感知选择器进行选择。
tldr: 本文提出CausalCache方法，通过重新分配有限视觉预算到高条件边际效用的历史事件，实现长程GUI智能体的高保真恢复，并引入HGKV适配器和预算感知选择器以提升性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CausalCache, which reallocates limited visual budget to historical events with higher conditional marginal utility for high-fidelity restoration in long-horizon GUI agents, introducing an HGKV adapter and budget-aware selector.
